recipes.title: Tante Irma's Pflaumenkuchen
Jean Baker's Apple Cake
recipes.description: Jean Baker's apple cake, mixed by hand and baked in a 9x13 pan, then sprinkled with powdered sugar once cold. Keeps well.
steps: Beat together the sugar, oil, vanilla, and eggs. Mix by hand.
Mix the flour, soda, cinnamon, and salt, and add to the wet mixture.
Stir in the diced apples and chopped nuts.
Bake at 350° for 40-45 minutes in a greased 9x13 pan.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar when cold. Keeps well.
recipes.sourceNote: Transcribed from a handwritten recipe card, October 2026. Wording preserved as written.

recipes.title: Jean Baker's Lemon Cake
recipes.description: A lemon bundt cake with a lemon glaze that drizzles down the sides.
steps: Mix the cake mix, pudding, eggs, water, and oil at medium speed for 2 minutes.
Pour into a bundt pan.
Bake 40-45 minutes.
Mix the lemon juice, powdered sugar, and lemon zest until medium consistency, not too thick. Put on top of the cake so it drizzles down the sides.

recipes.title: Apricot Biscotti
recipes.description: Twice-baked biscotti with dried apricots, light raisins, lemon peel, and almond extract.
steps: Beat the butter in a mixing bowl with a mixer on medium to high for 30 seconds.
Add the sugar and baking powder; beat till combined.
Beat in the eggs, lemon peel, and almond extract till combined.
Beat in as much flour as possible, then stir in any remaining flour and the fruit.
Divide the dough into thirds. Shape each portion into a 12-inch roll; place 3 inches apart on a slightly greased cookie sheet.
Flatten slightly to 1 1/2-inch width. Combine the egg yolk and milk; brush on the rolls.
Bake at 375° for 15-20 minutes or till lightly browned. Cool on the cookie sheet for 1 hour.
Transfer to a cutting board. Cut each loaf crosswise into 3/8-inch thick slices.
Lay the slices on a cookie sheet; bake at 325° for 5 minutes. Turn the slices over; bake about 5 minutes more or until dry and crisp.
Remove and cool on a wire rack. Makes about 90.

recipes.title: Amy Karle's Macaroni & Cheese
recipes.description: A blender-smooth extra-sharp cheddar sauce layered with elbow pasta and buttered bread crumbs. Card dated January 1, 1993.
steps: Blend all ingredients except the pasta in a blender.
Pour the mixture into a double boiler. Stir constantly until the cheese is melted and the mixture is smooth and thickened.
Cover and continue cooking on low 10-12 minutes, stirring every 4 minutes.
Layer the pasta, cheese sauce, and buttered bread crumbs in a casserole pan.
Bake at 325° for 45 minutes, covered with foil except for the last 5 minutes.
Options: add ham or sausage, or thin-sliced tomato.

recipes.title: Amy Karle's Chocolate Pudding
recipes.description: Stovetop chocolate pudding with unsweetened chocolate, finished with vanilla.
steps: Heat the flour, sugar, milk, and chocolate in a double boiler until thick and the chocolate is melted.
Cover and continue cooking for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add a dash of salt and 1 teaspoon vanilla.
Cover the pudding with wax paper.
